tex_content.label: prop:exterior-derivative-one-form
tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Exterior Derivative of a 1-form] 1. chB:B.12[LeeSM, Prop. 14.29] If $\omega $ is a smooth 1-form and $X, Y$ are vector fields, then \[ d\omega (X,Y) = X(\omega (Y)) - Y(\omega (X)) - \omega ([X,Y]). \]
